name: @algomancy/storybook
description: Storybook for the client's design-system components (ui/components/). Its own package so that ui/ keeps no dependencies and the gate never waits on it: nothing in `npm --prefix client run check` reaches this directory except the stories' TYPES, which ui/'s tsconfig checks (they import nothing from Storybook). The previews load the site's real stylesheet, ui/bundle.css, which `npm run css` builds from ui/styles/ — the same file the game server serves. README.md says how to run it and how to add a component.

scripts.build: npm run css && storybook build -o storybook-static
